item.title: Shenandoah Man Convicted in Schuylkill County Trial on Child Sexual Abuse Material Charges
item.description: A Schuylkill County man has been convicted following a jury trial on charges related to possession of child sexual abuse material. A Schuylkill County jury found Antony Cuff, 47, of Shenandoah, guilty of 17 felony counts of possession of child sexual abuse material and one felony count of criminal use of a communication facility. item.title: Pine Grove Pulls Away Late to Defeat Mahanoy Area in Schuylkill League Division 1 Clash
item.description: MAHANOY CITY, Pa. — Pine Grove picked up a key Schuylkill League Division 1 road win on Tuesday night, pulling away in the fourth quarter to defeat Mahanoy Area 66–58 in a league matchup. The win avenged an earlier loss for Pine Grove, which dropped the first meeting between the teams on December 4 by a 51–47 score.
